scripts.copy:frontend: shx mkdir -p backend/public && shx cp -r frontend/build/* backend/public/
scripts.assemble:cli: shx mkdir -p packages/cli/dist && shx cp backend/dist/index.js packages/cli/dist/ && shx mkdir -p packages/cli/public && shx cp -r backend/public/* packages/cli/public/ && shx cp -r backend/drizzle packages/cli/drizzle
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run assemble:cli
